# Reading an ABM paper {#intro-readings}

As a complement to this brief introduction, select one of the references mentioned in the previous session that contains details about an agent-based model in archaeology. You may also search for other references not included in the list, as long as they remain within an academic and archaeological context. Preferably, choose one that deals with topics that are familiar to you, so that the challenge lies in understanding the model description and its results and/or discussion, not its background theme or case study.
